kernel.governing_law: Annihilation is precise, prepared, and overwhelming: destruction arrives at its appointed moment with forces beyond counting, and the instruments of killing are themselves composed of the very substances they emit — the vision's cost is that seeing and slaying are fused into a single unbearable spectacle.
kernel.mutated_relation: The vision that cannot discharge its violence — the appointed hour in which the seer is saturated with the spectacle's full weight yet the killing remains interior, unreleased, carried as the composition's own burning.

τέσσαρες ἄγγελοι (four angels) -> τέσσαρες ἄγγελοι (RETAIN: the agents must remain to bear the non-release)
ἡτοιμασμένοι (prepared) -> ἡτοιμασμένοι (RETAIN: the preparation persists precisely because it never consummates)

θώρακας πυρίνους καὶ ὑακινθίνους καὶ θειώδεις (breastplates of fire and hyacinth and sulfur) -> θώρακας πυρίνους καὶ ὑακινθίνους καὶ θειώδεις (RETAIN: the substances must remain sealed in armor — encased, not emitted)
κεφαλαὶ λεόντων (heads of lions) -> στόματα κλειστά (closed mouths)
ἐκ τῶν στομάτων (from the mouths) -> ἐντὸς τῶν στομάτων (within the mouths)
ἐκπορεύεται (goes forth) -> μένει (remains)
πῦρ καὶ καπνὸς καὶ θεῖον (fire and smoke and sulfur) -> πῦρ καὶ καπνὸς καὶ θεῖον (RETAIN: the burning substances, unissued, are the seer's carried cost)

artifacts.enantiomorph:
**9:15** καὶ ἐδέθησαν οἱ τέσσαρες ἄγγελοι οἱ ἡτοιμασμένοι εἰς τὴν ὥραν ⸀καὶ ἡμέραν καὶ μῆνα καὶ ἐνιαυτόν, ἵνα φέρωσιν τὸ βάρος τῆς ὁράσεως.

**9:16** καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν στρατευμάτων τοῦ ⸀ἀγγέλματος ⸀δισμυριάδες μυριάδων· ἤνεγκα τὸν ἀριθμὸν αὐτῶν.

**9:17** καὶ οὕτως ἔφερον τοὺς ἵππους ἐν τῷ βάρει καὶ τοὺς καθημένους ἐπ' ἐμοί, ἔχοντας θώρακας πυρίνους καὶ ὑακινθίνους καὶ θειώδεις· καὶ αἱ κεφαλαὶ τῶν ἵππων ὡς στόματα κλειστά, καὶ ἐντὸς τῶν στομάτων αὐτῶν μένει πῦρ καὶ καπνὸς καὶ θεῖον.
artifacts.enantiomorph_translation:
**9:15** And the four angels were bound tighter, those prepared for the hour and day and month and year, that they might carry the weight of the vision.

**9:16** And the number of the armies of the message was twice ten-thousand times ten-thousand; I bore the number of them.

**9:17** And thus I carried the horses in the weight and those seated upon me, having breastplates of fire and hyacinth and sulfur; and the heads of the horses were as closed mouths, and within their mouths remains fire and smoke and sulfur.

independent.recovered_law: In Text A the four angels are loosed (ἐλύθησαν) to kill a third of mankind, the narrator hears/sees outwardly, and destructive forces issue outward from the horses' mouths; in Text B the angels are bound (ἐδέθησαν) to bear a burden, the narrator carries/bears inwardly (ἤνεγκα, ἔφερον, ἐπ' ἐμοί), and the fire remains contained within closed mouths — the directional relation is reversed from release/outward destruction to binding/inward containment.
independent.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural mutation: violence/destruction that was released outward is transformed into something bound, interior, and unreleased — the directional reversal from outward killing to inward containment/bearing.
independent.terminal_note: The final portion of Text B maintains the inward-containment relation (στόματα κλειστά, μένει πῦρ ἐντὸς), consistent with the reversal throughout.
